description: A small round zen garden tray filled with white sand sits on the tabletop, with a small rock and a light-colored stone inside and a yellow mini rake nearby. The left hand steadies the tray at its edge while the right hand lowers the yellow rake onto the sand and drags it in short, gentle strokes across the upper-right area, smoothing and re-grooving the sand as the right hand lifts and repositions the rake between passes.
